e8b_preregistration.status: design accepted; implementation/testing/preflight/review authorised; training, the eight-point search, the G19 pilot and all scientific evaluation NOT authorised

user_decisions.U1: APPROVED: defer B4 and B4r (SmolLM2-360M) together from E8B-min. A deferral, not a cancellation: preserved as a separately authorised conditional E10 size-sensitivity extension after E8B and E9. No 360M path is implemented or run now. Consequences as stated in the accepted design: the pre-registered 135M-versus-360M size contrast is removed at both scales and the selection-sensitivity analysis is halved to two pretrained-135M configurations (one-sided).
user_decisions.U2: REJECTED: no pre-authorised 250k-only fallback. If the unconditional 18-core-run matrix becomes infeasible under measured projections, execution stops and returns to the user. No automatic removal of 40k arms, selection-sensitivity configurations or any causal pair.
user_decisions.U3: APPROVED: expected-epoch 15/22 projection basis for G19 go/no-go, WITH binding additions: the 100-epoch worst-case projection is always reported beside it; the eight-hour per-run hard wall stands; all projections are recomputed after the G19 multiplier pilot AND again after the eight-point search before core execution; no arm is ever descoped automatically; any projected resource-gate failure stops and returns.
user_decisions.U4_OPEN: REPORTED AMBIGUITY, decision required before core execution: the canonical plan counts '30 core training runs, plus 8 search runs... 38 E8B training runs in total' (section 3), implying the B3/40k/seed-0 core run is executed afresh under the frozen recipe even though one search run has the identical configuration; the E8A precedent instead promoted valid seed-0 pilots as core cells without rerunning. Because bf16 training is not bitwise repeatable, the choice changes which checkpoint becomes canonical and must not be made after results are observed. The runner refuses to execute or promote the B3/40k/seed-0 core cell until the user decides: (a) promote the winning search checkpoint, or (b) rerun the cell under the frozen recipe as the 38-run arithmetic implies. Neither option is implemented as a default.
